name: manual_d4264e
claim: In PowerShell launcher scripts, invoke helper scripts with the call operator '&' rather than dot-sourcing '.' so helper variables and functions do not leak into the caller's scope.

decisions.notes: start.ps1 sources .paths.ps1 via dot-source by design (it must export variables), but helper scripts like ensure-partner-cli-paths.ps1 should run in their own scope. Using '&' keeps the launcher scope clean and avoids accidental overrides.
